rationale: Third-party injury (neighbor's child) to a non-household member arising from the condition of the policyholder's premises (icy walkway).
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter suffered a broken wrist after slipping on the icy walkway in front of the policyholder's house during last week's ice storm. Parents are pursuing medical bills. Pediatric injury claim with $500,000 liability coverage available.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped and fell on icy walkway
